description: What people are reading on Wikipedia: a day's most-viewed articles in any language edition, with views, change against the day before (or new entry), desktop and mobile shares, short description, thumbnail and link. Pages whose traffic looks automated are flagged and left out; the main page and non-article pages are skipped. Sort by views or by views gained. Latest day by default, or any day since July 2015. Data: Wikimedia Pageviews (CC0). Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the latest published day)

include_automated.description: Keep pages whose traffic looks automated (default false)

sort.description: views (default) or rising (views gained on the day before)

name: wikipedia_trending
